results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite (if campaign_id unknown)]: Locate the source campaign using MAILCHIMP_LIST_CAMPAIGNS (filter with MAILCHIMP_SEARCH_CAMPAIGNS if many results).
[Optional (to confirm you’re cloning the right campaign)] [Prerequisite]: Review key metadata using MAILCHIMP_GET_CAMPAIGN_INFO.
[Required] [Step]: Create a new duplicated campaign draft using MAILCHIMP_REPLICATE_CAMPAIGN (capture the new campaign_id).
[Optional (if subject/from name/other settings must differ)] [Step]: Update the duplicated draft using MAILCHIMP_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN_SETTINGS.
[Optional (if email body must differ)] [Step]: Replace or edit content on the duplicated draft using MAILCHIMP_SET_CAMPAIGN_CONTENT.
known_pitfalls: [MAILCHIMP_REPLICATE_CAMPAIGN] Replication returns a draft-like campaign (status reflects a saved draft), not a ready-to-send campaign.
[MAILCHIMP_REPLICATE_CAMPAIGN] The duplicated campaign may have an empty send_time; plan on reviewing/scheduling separately.
[MAILCHIMP_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN_SETTINGS] Settings changes (e.g., subject/title) are handled separately from body content; don’t expect content updates to modify settings.
[MAILCHIMP_SET_CAMPAIGN_CONTENT] Content edits require using the duplicated campaign_id returned by MAILCHIMP_REPLICATE_CAMPAIGN, not the source campaign_id.
